description: This file defines an AppSearchController class for managing search-related state in a Flutter application, including search queries, recent searches, and results. It interacts with content repository, cache, and database services, and implements methods for executing searches, managing recents, and handling cache refreshes.

classes.name: AppSearchController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier class managing search queries, recent searches, and results with support for cache and database persistence.

methods.name: loadRecent
methods.description: Loads recent searches from cache and optionally from the database.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the current search query and resets error messages.

methods.name: _persistRecent
methods.description: Persists a search query to cache and database.

methods.name: _runQuery
methods.description: Executes a search query via the repository, updates results, recents, and handles errors.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Triggers a search using the current query, showing loading state.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Revalidates the current search results from cache.

methods.name: clearRecent
methods.description: Clears recent searches from cache and database.
